displayName: Room server: near its socket capacity

documentation.content: More than 80 % of the sockets the room server can hold are open: concurrency per instance times the maximum number of instances, as `deploy-environment.yml` sets them. Raise one of them, within the connections the database allows, and this threshold with them.

conditions.displayName: Open sockets above 80 % of 80 per instance × 2 instances
